speaker: Doctor
text: Let me start by understanding your recent symptoms. You mentioned fatigue, flank pain, and fever after treating acute sinusitis with antibiotics. When did these new symptoms begin, and did they improve or worsen after finishing your antibiotic course?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling tired, feverish, and I have flank pain. These symptoms continued even after my sinus symptoms improved.

speaker: Doctor
text: Did the flank pain radiate to your groin, and have you noticed any changes in your urine, such as blood, cloudiness, or foul odor? Also, please tell me if you have experienced nausea, vomiting, or chills along with the fever.

speaker: Patient
